options.label: Road to Chennai
options.evidence: Leaving through Chennai instead of Nhava Sheva changes both the inland run and the sailing: road goes from 21 km to 645 km, adding 370 kg; the 702 km rail leg goes away, saving 175 kg; ocean goes from 6,384 km to 5,002 km, saving 290 kg. Most of the difference is the road leg, which is charged per truck run rather than per tonne, so the distance driven is the whole of it. The workbook already sails Chennai → Laem Chabang 7 times and runs that inland chain on 7 shipments, so both halves of this route are ones it has already used.
